item.title: Living Longer at Age 80
item.description: Upon reaching the age of 80, men and women are living longer than ever before. These gains in longevity among octogenarians represent a remarkable demographic achievement. item.title: Afghanistan: UN tells Taliban to open up on abuses committed by security forces
item.description: Five years into Taliban rule, Afghans still have almost no way of knowing whether soldiers, police and morality officers who abuse their power ever face consequences – and that secrecy is corroding trust in the State, the UN said Monday.

item.title: UN calls for urgent action to protect children from online information risks
item.description: More than eight in 10 young people aged 15 to 24 worldwide are now online, and in low-income countries they outpace the rest of the population nearly two to one.

item.title: Humanitarian aid warehouses come under attack in Ukraine
item.description: Russia’s ongoing full-scale invasion of Ukraine has left civilians vulnerable to repeated deadly attacks and humanitarian workers and key facilities being targeted and destroyed.

item.title: Lebanon: UN peacekeepers count hundreds of Israeli strikes and incursions in a single weekend
item.description: Israeli forces fired 455 projectiles into south Lebanon and breached Lebanese airspace 97 times between Friday and Sunday, the UN's peacekeeping mission in the country reported Monday – among the heaviest fire seen in months.

item.title: UN offers support to Colombia after magnitude 7.4 earthquake kills dozens
item.description: The UN offered its support to Colombia on Monday after a magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck the west of the country, killing at least 111 people and injuring at least 87, including several children, while leaving others trapped under the rubble and causing landslides and serious damage to homes and infrastructure.

item.title: DR Congo: Ebola is killing people before they ever reach a doctor
item.description: More than 1,900 people have died in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak – and most of them never made it to a treatment centre. Between 60 and 70 per cent of deaths are happening in communities far from care, a gap that is now central to the World Health Organization's response.

item.title: Fighting deepens needs and fuels further displacement in Sudan
item.description: Ongoing conflict, displacement and funding shortages continue to deepen needs in Sudan, the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Monday, underscoring the need for greater civilian protection.
